caelestia.role: Initial upstream source baseline; local port commits follow this commit.

quickshell.role: Windows backend and QML compatibility interfaces. Preserves nunreasonable/quickshell e8ae0ef124b1c14b547c80d00422d2ffbd423d81, native mask hover handoff, Core Audio capability/error reporting, UPower observation validity, GSMTC initialization/session-scan status, profile-isolated artwork caching, verified power profile results, confirm-only Bluetooth pairing, opt-in strict brightness routes with owned gamma restoration, explicit-consent notification mirroring, M3 tiling/Hypr window observation with allowlist scope and fitting outcomes, the single-desktop placeholder fix, 64-bit brightness query request ids, DPI-unaware tiling placement, and native virtual-desktop workspace dispatch, and global hotkeys. Branch windows/integration-3.

m3shapes.role: Material 3 Expressive shape QML plugin. Upstream Caelestia split it into this external project (caelestia-dots/shell 24aa15ee) and pins the same revision in flake.nix/flake.lock. The Windows portable plugin build compiles and installs the M3Shapes QML module.

iiWindowsReference.role: Porting and packaging reference. Its sources.lock supplies the backend pin; it is not the Caelestia UI dependency.
